name: Prisma Compute Free
free_limit: 1 million requests/month; 360 GB-hours memory/month; 4 active vCPU-hours/month; 10 GB outbound bandwidth/month
watch_out: Free has a fixed $0 spend limit, requires no credit card and never bills usage overages. If ANY monthly request, provisioned-memory, active-CPU or outbound-bandwidth allowance is exceeded, the workspace's apps pause until the next month or a plan upgrade; do not mistake a traffic spike for billable overage. An idle app scales to zero. Starter and higher tiers bill memory, CPU and outbound bandwidth from the first unit, plus requests beyond their included quotas; paid spend limits must be configured separately. TypeScript hosting (Node.js, Bun, Next.js).
